verdicts.claim: the six texts are the files of data/sources.json, byte for byte; no TEST passage is read by the cards or by the trace model's fitting (scrambling every TEST passage leaves every card and the fitted model unchanged); every kept maxim passes the gate; every card rebuilds byte for byte from the committed local-model replies; every perspective and every judge batch was answered to its sealed prompt (the prompt's hash recorded with each reply); the name rule was applied to every perspective
verdicts.measured: texts as recorded true; TEST never read true; every kept maxim passes the gate true; cards rebuild byte for byte true; maxims asked to their sealed prompts true; 200 perspectives to their sealed prompts and seeds true (0 asked again, 0 still named); judge batches to their sealed prompts true (200 of 200 lines readable); the name rule applied true

verdicts.claim: THE TRACES ARE DISTINCT: the trace model attributes TEST passages to the right mind with a macro-averaged accuracy (the mean of the six minds' recalls) of at least 0.80, and every mind's recall is at least 0.50
verdicts.measured: macro accuracy 0.956684 on 727 TEST passages; marcus 49/52, montaigne 417/418, emerson 63/64, james 47/50, nietzsche 45/49, thoreau 90/94

verdicts.claim: THE STOCK GROWS: all six minds keep at least 8 maxims through the gate, so all six cards grow
verdicts.measured: marcus 19 of 24 kept, montaigne 21 of 24 kept, emerson 22 of 24 kept, james 21 of 24 kept, nietzsche 22 of 24 kept, thoreau 21 of 24 kept

verdicts.claim: A MIND IS RECOGNISED: of the 120 perspectives written from the cards, the judge recognises the card's mind in at least 40%, and the Wilson 95% lower bound of that rate is above 1/6, the chance of picking one of six
verdicts.measured: 114 of 120 recognised (0.95, Wilson 0.895196–0.976886; chance 0.166667); by mind marcus 20/20, montaigne 20/20, emerson 18/20, james 18/20, nietzsche 18/20, thoreau 20/20

verdicts.claim: NOT A SHAM: the Wilson 95% lower bound of the card perspectives' recognition rate is above the Wilson 95% upper bound of the sham perspectives' rate (60 perspectives from cards of pooled maxims, scored as the mind they are labelled with)
verdicts.measured: cards 0.895196 (lower bound) against shams 0.180692 (upper bound; 5 of 60)

verdicts.claim: RECOGNISED WITHOUT A LANGUAGE MODEL: the trace model, fitted on FIT passages of the old books, attributes the 120 card perspectives to the card's mind at a rate whose Wilson 95% lower bound is above 1/6
verdicts.measured: the trace model: 57 of 120 (0.475, Wilson 0.387819–0.563732); by mind marcus 2/20, montaigne 2/20, emerson 20/20, james 20/20, nietzsche 12/20, thoreau 1/20

verdicts.claim: THE JUDGE TELLS A MIND FROM NONE: the judge's mean number for 'none' is higher on the 20 base perspectives than on the 120 card perspectives, the paired-free bootstrap 95% lower bound of the difference above 0 (2,000 resamples of each group, seed 99)
verdicts.measured: mean "none": base 80.7 (20 readable) against cards 13.416667 (120 readable); bound 64.25
